Tutorial bank chapter, both changed lines hold against the code. The sentence omits Britain's fixed-rate exclusion (inCoolingOff, accountlife.ts:132), as it did before; guide/money.ts:485 says it. True, and 'sixty days' reads correctly beside the sentence's own '(in France, two months after the bank gives notice)'.
